synopsis: BEPU means “best estimate plus uncertainty”: it uses the most realistic model available and reports a quantified uncertainty band rather than stacking conservative assumptions [f14647]. The glossary contrasts this approach with reporting a single worst-case number [f14640]. However, Chapter 10 and the glossary both state that the booklet did not individually verify BEPU or the older CSAU method, limiting the evidential basis for its discussion of nuclear simulation credibility [f7665, f14648].

relations.note: Both state that BEPU and CSAU were not verified for the booklet.
Adds realistic-model selection and avoidance of stacked conservative assumptions to BEPU's uncertainty-based reporting.
